title: iberis sempervirens subsp. saxatilis
intro: Iberis sempervirens subsp. saxatilis, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. Rock Cress is believed to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Iberis sempervirens subsp. saxatilis include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is necessary to confirm the exact mechanisms of its effects.
